item.title: Tuesday 1 PM Update, Oct 20
item.description:
The Tuesday one o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for October 20, 2026: a granddaughter of Robert and Ethel Kennedy has died at 42, Florida prepares for its 18th execution of the year, and the NBA season opens with LeBron James' Philadelphia debut; mediators bring a new proposal to Iran and the U.S. as the Pentagon disputes Iran's tanker-mine claim, a drone strike kills at least 153 at a market in Abyei, and charges in the attack on an Australian MP; a midday rally led by blue chips and health care as oil eases, with pending home sales at a record low; Zoom's deepfake detector and Yelp's AI that phones restaurants for you; Anthropic says it will rewrite parts of its leaked AI bill; ConnectWise's cloud backup still offline and Hannaford back online; your X feed with Krea's image model, The Prestige in IMAX, a homemade jukebox and the end of the Hartford Times; Route 101 glare crashes, an offshore nor'easter and Ciao Italia in Nashua; and an Arizona teen who gave a stranger the shoes off his feet. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Tuesday 10 AM Update, Oct 20
item.description:

Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Tuesday Morning, Oct 20
item.description:

Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
